question: What reward did Chisha receive? Since he contributed so much to Emperor Vincent Vollachia's rule, which follows the motto “Reward Virtue and Punish Vice,” I'm very curious...! I'd also like to know about any unusual rewards the Nine Divine Generals received.
answer:
Since the Nine Divine Generals hold high positions, I imagine they received something within Emperor Vincent's power to grant when they became generals.

Each of them probably received something they couldn't have obtained through their own power, but could obtain through the power of the Empire.

For example, Cecilus received a wicked sword that had been kept in the castle...

Well, after receiving it, he melted it down and had Groovy reforge it, so it's more like, “Give me a break!” (laughs)

I think Yorna receiving the Chaos Frame was a similar case.

So, following that pattern...

There's a possibility that Chisha didn't receive anything at all.

Chisha probably said, “I'll think about it,” and until he made his decision, it would have been impossible to dismiss him from his position.

It's likely that Chisha remained at Vincent's side until the decision was made, because it would be a disgrace for Vincent—who follows the principle of “Reward Virtue and Punish Vice”—to be unable to give his vassal what he wanted.
